about.title: Hi, I'm oF
about.subtitle: Full-Stack Engineer | Knowledge Graphs & Language Model Applications
about.content:
I hold a master’s degree in Information Management and have over one year of full-stack development experience. I have worked on manufacturing dashboards, e-paper and IoT applications, and fall detection systems.
Alongside system development, I also work on research and implementation involving knowledge graphs, graph neural networks, and language models, with applications in recommender systems and sentiment and semantic analysis. My experience includes data processing, model training, experimental validation, front-end and back-end development, databases, and hardware–software integration.

items.title: Knowledge Graph–Based Recommendation Research
items.description: This research integrates users’ dynamic preferences, sentiment and semantic information from reviews, and relationships among product attributes. It uses multi-head attention to fuse the features and build a personalized recommendation method.

items.title: Point-of-Interest Recommendation
items.description: Contributed to research on graph neural networks and sentiment and semantic analysis, with responsibility for reproducing experiments, adjusting model evaluation methods, checking data, and running ablation studies.

items.title: Fall Detection System
items.description: The system uses human pose estimation and temporal models to distinguish normal, loss-of-balance, and fall states, with real-time video, event notifications, and environmental sensing integrated.

highlights: Contributed to the development of e-paper device management and IoT systems.
Worked on front-end and back-end features, plus database and device communication integration.
Contributed to electronic dashboards and management systems for manufacturing.
Developed system features, back-end APIs, and analytical reports, and integrated databases.

items.degree: Department of Information Management | Master of Business Administration
items.topic: A Knowledge Graph–Based Recommendation Method Integrating Users’ Dynamic Preferences and Sentiment-Semantic Features
items.description: Explored personalized recommendation methods by combining users’ evolving preferences, sentiment semantics from reviews, and product knowledge graphs.

items.degree: Department of Information and Communication Engineering | Bachelor of Engineering
items.description: Built a fall detection system using human posture, temporal analysis, real-time monitoring, and IoT devices. The project received an Honorable Mention in the Department of Information and Communication Engineering’s 2023 practical project competition.
